        encoder=enc,
        decoder=dec,
        mm_field=DummyField(),
        letter_case=LetterCase.SNAKE,
        undefined=Undefined.IGNORE,
        field_name="custom_name",

    )

    result = config(
        metadata=metadata,
        field_name="fixed_name",
